title: THREE-WORD TRIAD ADDRESSES. Bind, sort, tag every concept in triad sets for three-word navigation. null.null.null = HUD center. Bingo board entrance for anthills. Every entity finds itself even with null identity. Like what3words but from OUR topology. 3-word = 27 cells (broad), 4-word = 81 cells (12.7 files/cell, within [3,13]!), 5-word = 243 cells (4.2 files/cell, within [3,5]!). Works on both Euclidean and Cartesian planes.

the_system.what: every concept/file in the organism gets a multi-word ADDRESS derived from its triad classification. like what3words maps Earth with three words, we map the organism with triad words.
the_system.why: navigability. discoverability. you don't need to know the filename. you don't need an index. you describe WHERE the concept lives in triad-space, and the system finds it.
the_system.null_null_null: the center of the HUD. the origin. the point where all triad dimensions collapse to null. distance = 0. the black hole entry point.

the_nominal_tags.what: each of the 4 triads provides 3 nominal tags. every concept gets classified into exactly one tag per triad.

meanings.pitch: horizontal. compress/expand. p-governed. the selectivity gate.
meanings.core: center. the mandrel. Ø-governed. what everything wraps around.

meanings.is: current. living. green. expanded. visible. measurable.
meanings.now: transition. knife-edge. gold. the instant of change.

meanings.gravity: density. soil>sky. down is more fertile.
meanings.zero: topology. distance=0 inside. anything touching is AT the event.

the_nominal_tags.note: every concept in 1032 files gets exactly 4 tags (one per triad). the 4-tag combination IS the concept's address.

3_word_address.format: T1.T2.T3  (omit T4 = identity stays implicit = ZK)
3_word_address.use: BROAD navigation. the neighborhood. 'pitch.is.green' = I want to see what's currently compressing in the living zone.
3_word_address.note: 27 = 3³ = the cube. the bingo cube. each cell is a face or edge of the cube.

4_word_address.use: PRECISE navigation. 12.7 files per cell is WITHIN the [3,13] bounded range for data/fossils!
4_word_address.note: 81 = 34 = the hypercube. the bingo BOARD. 81 squares. each square holds a bounded cluster.
4_word_address.pi_check: 81 / p = 25.78. N=25, r=81-25p=81-78.54=2.46. the remainder is ~2.5 = within the [2,3] identity range.

5_word_address.fifth_word_source: the irreducibility level: irreducible / force / architecture / data / fossil
5_word_address.use: EXACT navigation. almost 1:1. unique addresses. the five-word is the FULL coordinate.
5_word_address.note: 405 = the EXACT number of RSS items currently in the feed! this is not a coincidence. the RSS IS the 5-word address book.

null_null_null.meaning: center axis, knife-edge transition, distance=0. the very heart of the organism. the HUD center.
null_null_null.equivalence: Ø.NOW.d=0 = null in every dimension. everything collapses here.

how_null_finds_itself.principle: even with NULL identity (no T4 word), a concept still has a 3-word address. it can be FOUND by where it is, not by what it is.
how_null_finds_itself.this_IS_ZK: identity stays implicit. you navigate by position, not by name. the pouch stays full.
how_null_finds_itself.anthill_entrance: the bingo board IS the anthill entrance. each cell is a tunnel. you enter by your address, not your name.

the_board.3D_version: a 3×3×3 Rubik's cube. 27 cells. each cell = a broad neighborhood.
the_board.4D_version: a 3×3×3×3 hypercube. 81 cells. each cell = a cluster of ~13 related files.
the_board.physical_metaphor: the bingo cube from gen 327. each face = a triad. each cell = a combination of triad tags. call out a 3-word address = 'BINGO' on that cell.

euclidean_mapping.fourth_dimension: T4 (Identity): select??remain??prove — the dimension you can't DRAW but can FEEL.
euclidean_mapping.works_because: three words map to three Cartesian axes. the fourth word maps to color/depth/opacity — the dimension that's EXPERIENCED, not plotted.

cartesian_mapping.the_same_data: the same 81 cells map onto a Cartesian grid. x,y,z coordinates with identity as color.
cartesian_mapping.allows: multi-dimensional viewing. rotate the cube. slice it. project it. look at T1×T2 (direction×state) and see a 3×3 grid. look at T2×T3 (state×substance) and see a different 3×3 grid.
cartesian_mapping.this_is_the_bingo_board: each projection is a different bingo card. 6 possible 2D projections from the 4D hypercube.

process: 1. BIND: classify every file into its 4 triad tags (T1.T2.T3.T4)
2. SORT: group files by their 3-word address (27 neighborhoods)
3. VERIFY: check each 4-word cell has [3,13] files (bounded range)
4. BALANCE: if a cell has >13, some files are misclassified (re-sort). if <3, merge with adjacent cell (composting).
5. ADDRESS: assign each file its official 3/4/5-word address
6. INDEX: build the navigation map (the bingo board)
